# Markdown Viewer

> A small, fast Android app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose) that opens Markdown files from any app and
> renders GitHub-flavoured Markdown in light and dark. No permissions, no network. Apache-2.0,
> made by Babak Bandpey at Cocode.

Application id `dk.cocode.markdownviewer`. `render/` turns Markdown into an HTML page with pure
functions; `ui/` hosts it in a WebView. All tests run on the JVM with Robolectric.
